name: Badge
summary: A small count or status marker — notification counts, unread dots, a standalone status label.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-badge> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. The DS V3 Badge is a family: `count` renders a number pill on the top-right of a wrapped child (capped by `overflowCount` as N+, kept at 0 with `showZero`); `dot` renders a bare marker; `status` + `text` renders a standalone semantic dot + label (success/processing/error/default/warning), with `processing` pulsing; `color` overrides the colour. Shadow-DOM CSS themed only by --aha-* tokens; the pill scales in on a persistent node. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: a count or presence marker attached to another element (a bell, a tab, an avatar)
a standalone semantic state label (Published, Generating, Failed) in a list or header
a standalone label/keyword chip with text but no status semantics

opinion.note: A count/dot marks another element — wrap the element it belongs to so the pill anchors to its top-right. Keep counts meaningful; cap large numbers with overflowCount so the bubble stays small. Reserve the standalone status form for a semantic lifecycle state, and let processing pulse rather than spin a separate loader.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Badge component-set taxonomy: Badge/Count, Badge/Dot, Badge/Status (状态), Badge/Text, Badge/On-Icon, Badge/On-Image, Badge/Dot-On-Text — i.e. the family carries a count pill, a bare dot, a standalone status dot+label, and placement over a wrapped icon/image/text child. antd Badge conventions supply the count sizing (18px bubble, 8×8 dot, 11/18 SemiBold), overflowCount N+, showZero, and the status set (success/processing/error/default/warning). Token layer: count/dot default color-error, status→color-success/warning/primary(processing)/text-tertiary(default), radius-pill, text-inverse, bg-container ring. The measured component standard has no badge cell — a deliberate, documented extension, not a measured match.
